exclusions.title: Additional outbuilding: garden shed trim
exclusions.reason: The article attributes Moody Blue SW 6221 trim and Mountain Air SW 6224 walls to a GMH Construction garden shed. It is an outbuilding, not a house, so it is linked as a further reference and is outside the house-photo counts.

exclusions.title: Ambersand: the main body is Tradewind
exclusions.reason: The original builder’s answer confirms Tradewind siding, Extra White trim and Moody Blue shutters. Only the useful shutter-bearing front view is included. Rear, boardwalk and through-window images are excluded.

exclusions.title: Unresolved contractor lead: Clemens cottage
exclusions.reason: Search results associate a DLux Custom Finishes cottage project with Moody Blue. The accessible business page did not establish which project photographs belong to that statement, so no image was assigned to it.

exclusions.title: Unverified Mount Pleasant exterior
exclusions.reason: A real house appeared in broad Houzz results, but the available listing did not establish Moody Blue as its paint. Search-result proximity and visual resemblance are insufficient.

exclusions.title: “Moody blue” digital design examples
exclusions.reason: The phrase can describe a general color mood and other named blue paints. Digital exterior designs are not counted as photographs documenting SW 6221 actually applied to a house.

exclusions.title: Digital concepts, AI renderings and color simulations
exclusions.reason: Digital visualizations and generated exterior concepts are excluded. A realistic rendering is not evidence of a real painted house.

exclusions.title: A proposed door color that was not selected
exclusions.reason: Moody Blue was a considered alternative. The actual painted front door in this post is Exclusive Plum, so its completed photo is excluded.

exclusions.title: Reddit front-door voting thread
exclusions.reason: A suggestion or sample does not establish the final paint. The update identifies Peppery as the chosen door color, so this is not a completed Moody Blue application.

exclusions.title: Repeated house image across reference sites
exclusions.reason: The Lauren Harrell house is repeated by PLAN Home, Paint Color Consultants and Pinterest. It is counted once, using the larger recovered copy. Other duplicate sizes and reposts were likewise removed.

exclusions.title: Interiors, before photos and swatches
exclusions.reason: Most images in the database are interior rooms or furniture. Only the three relevant exterior photos are retained. Gold-house before photos, WaterColor interiors, color chips, rejected paint samples and manufacturer color schedules are outside the collection.

exclusions.title: Social-source access limits
exclusions.reason: Some credited original social captions could not be recovered. An Instagram navigation attempt also stalled when the browser’s automatic permission check timed out. Those photos retain secondary-attribution labels; no original-owner confirmation is implied.

methodology: Searched public text and image results using Moody Blue, Sherwin-Williams, SW 6221/SW6221, exterior, siding, house, painting, before/after, homeowner, door and shutter terms. Checked contractor portfolios, designer projects, homeowner discussions and updates, public social posts, Houzz paint answers, credited design publications, Pinterest reposts and manufacturer material. Followed project photos and source credits, visually inspected the saved images, and removed known duplicate compositions. Source-confirmed body color requires an original professional or homeowner statement; secondary body attributions have a separate category. Exterior accents have their own category, with primary versus secondary evidence explained in each group. Different angles remain, but image counts are not house counts. Some accent photos show the painted detail only at a distance or in shadow. No recoloring or generated imagery was introduced. This is a thorough public-web collection, not a guarantee of every photograph in existence: private, deleted, unindexed, login-restricted or inaccessible posts may contain more.
